Dwarf_Commoner
Skonal Dehann is one of the customers waiting in line at the Counting House in the Lower City.
“
Why the hells are they so slow? Meadhoney usually runs a tighter ship than this.
„
— Skonal Dehann

Involvement

Skonal stands in the rightmost line waiting his turn to get serviced by an employee of the Counting House. Before him  Brid Hunley is waiting, trying to catch the attention of  Cashier Stivvo in a somewhat inappropriate manner. He is unhappy about the service of the Counting House and remarks that  Head Clerk Meadhoney used to 'run a tighter ship'.
